name: Aqua Harvest
tagline: Water wisely. Grow a thriving farm.
description: A colorful, hardcore arcade farm game featuring a young Bukidnon farmer using a smart watering device to manage water wisely and grow healthy crops.

name: AQUEST - The Dark Forest
tagline: Flashlight on. Buckets full. Stay alive.
description: A top-down horror survival quest where you play as a boy with a flashlight collecting water buckets in a dark forest while evading a mysterious creature.

name: BROPIPE
tagline: Fix the pipes. Save the water.
description: Fix the broken pipes and help save the community's water in this fast-paced arcade game.

name: Bukidnon Interactive Illustrated Tourism Map
tagline: Explore Bukidnon's mountains, one tap at a time.
description: An animated, colorful 3D-illustrated tourism map and travel guide showcasing Bukidnon's mountains, rivers, pineapples, cultural landmarks, and adventure destinations.

name: Bukidnon Tourism Platform
tagline: Discover, plan, and book your Bukidnon trip.
description: Interactive discovery, animated map navigation, real-time operating status, weather awareness, and booking platform for Bukidnon province.

name: DROP IT! — The Great Water Panic
tagline: Guide Bloop through 100 levels of water-saving chaos.
description: A cute comedy-adventure, puzzle, strategy, resource-management, and water-conservation game following Bloop the water-drop guardian in Splashville across 100 levels.

name: Drop Quest
tagline: Collect every drop before the drought wins.
description: A 2D side-scrolling platformer game where a farmer collects water drops to save the drought-stricken farm before time runs out.

name: Farmer's Water Quest: Wild Harvest
tagline: 30 maps. One thirsty farm. Survive the wild.
description: A realistic top-down wilderness survival and farming simulation where you guide a farmer across 30 expansive maps to collect water from springs, dodge dangerous predators, and nourish dying plants with immersive dynamic soundscapes.

name: Fire & Water Scatter Game
tagline: Chase combo cascades of fire and water.
description: An elemental scatter game featuring fire bombs, water diamonds, combo cascades, dynamic arcade and grid scatter modes with custom audio and particle physics.

name: Gardening
tagline: Plant, water, and grow a coin-earning garden.
description: A cozy farming game where you plant, water, nurture, and harvest crops to earn coins, level up, and unlock rare exotic seeds.

name: Landscape Water Box Puzzle
tagline: Push, route, and nurture across 40 levels.
description: A 40-level landscape puzzle game where you push water containers, manipulate terrain obstacles, route streams, and nurture wilting plants to life.

name: Lantaw
tagline: Discover, plan, and book across Bukidnon.
description: Lantaw is Bukidnon's illustrated tourism discovery, live operational status, weather navigation, and owner-managed booking platform.

name: Maze Runner: The Thirst
tagline: Flashlight shadows. Water physics. No time to stop.
description: A juicy, atmospheric top-down arcade maze runner with dynamic flashlight shadows, synthesized Web Audio, water physics, and power-ups.

name: Night Shift
tagline: Watch the cameras. Trust nothing.
description: A realistic security camera horror game.

name: Garden Farmer: 30 Level Harvest Quest
tagline: Keep the crops watered across 30 levels.
description: An action gardening game where you control a farmer watering thirsty crops across 30 escalating levels to keep them from shrinking and drying out.

name: Water Hero: Save Every Drop
tagline: Dodge snakes. Fill the village tank.
description: A colorful cartoon maze game raising awareness for community water scarcity where players navigate obstacles, avoid snakes, collect clean water drops, and fill the village water tank.

name: Alertify Incident Report Library
tagline: Monitor and prioritize citizen disaster reports.
description: A modern, high-speed civic response dashboard for monitoring, reviewing, and prioritizing citizen-submitted disaster reports.

name: Bagyo
tagline: Grab supplies. Beat the rising flood. One minute.
description: An intense flood escape survival game where Dexter must gather essential typhoon supplies and reach the rescue boat before 1 minute runs out as floodwaters rise.

name: Boat Race
tagline: Two players. Three rivers. One champion.
description: A vibrant 2D competitive boat-racing game featuring two players, 3 distinct river paths, 5 lives system, and 2-round championship.

name: Calumpit CBFMMP Flood & Weather Monitor
tagline: Real-time flood telemetry and evacuation guidance.
description: Community-Based Flood Mitigation Management & Early Warning System for Calumpit, Bulacan, providing real-time river telemetry, dam spill alerts, high-tide tracking, evacuation routing, and AI-powered resident safety advisories.

name: Calumpit Flood & Weather Hydro-Met System
tagline: River confluence monitoring and alert dispatch.
description: Real-time flood telemetry, dual-river confluence & tidal delta monitoring, SHINe observer portal, and automated multi-channel BDRRMC alert dispatch for Calumpit, Bulacan.

name: Earthquakes Survival
tagline: Rescue survivors before the timer runs out.
description: An action-packed disaster rescue survival game. Drive your rescue vehicle through an earthquake-struck city, rescue stranded survivors, and transport them to the Safe Zone before the 3-minute timer expires.

name: Eye of Destruction — Disaster Rescue Endless Runner
tagline: Drive. Dodge debris. Rescue survivors. Rebuild.
description: 3D action-adventure endless runner where you drive Rose's rescue van through disaster zones, dodge debris, rescue injured survivors, repair destroyed buildings, and restore the city.

name: Flowing Boat
tagline: Outrun the tidal wave down the rapids.
description: An action-packed 2D cartoon river survival game where an old man escapes a chasing tidal wave on foot and down dangerous river rapids to reach the finish line.

name: Funrun LeGEND
tagline: Dodge rocks and logs. Reach the safe zone.
description: An action-packed obstacle fun-run game featuring customizable boy and girl runners dodging rolling rocks and tree trunks to reach the safe zone.

name: InnoVision
tagline: AI-powered LoRa flood forecasting and early warning.
description: AI-Powered LoRa Flood Forecasting and Early Warning System.

name: BROPIPE
tagline: Repair the leaks. Save the water supply.
description: A 2D browser maze game where a plumber repairs leaking water pipes to save the community water supply.

name: The Killers
tagline: Katana up. Save survivors. Clear every level.
description: An action survival zombie shooter and slasher where you wield a katana and pistols with reinforced armor to save trapped victims and exterminate dangerous zombie strains across challenging levels.

name: FETCH
tagline: Carry the water. Beat the mountain.
description: Carry the water from the mountain spring to the village before the bucket runs dry. A minimalist arcade mountain maze adventure built in Google AI Studio.

name: Pixel Garden
tagline: Grow a garden, one tap at a time.
description: Plant seeds, water your crops, and watch a colorful pixel garden bloom. A chill creative game made by DEVCON Kids.

name: Robo Race
tagline: Code your robot to the finish line.
description: Guide a friendly robot through obstacle courses using simple commands. Race against the clock and unlock new tracks.

name: Space Quiz Blast
tagline: Answer fast. Explore the stars.
description: A fast-paced quiz adventure through the solar system. Pick the right answers to fuel your rocket and reach new planets.

name: Eco Heroes
tagline: Clean the city. Save the day.
description: Help eco-heroes recycle trash, plant trees, and keep the neighborhood green. Learn sustainability while having fun.

name: Math Maze
tagline: Solve puzzles to escape the maze.
description: Find your way out of a colorful maze by solving quick math challenges. Every correct answer opens a new path.

name: Story Spark
tagline: Choose your adventure.
description: Build your own story by picking what happens next. Meet quirky characters and unlock surprise endings.
